history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration further clarify the conditions of and criteria for roster-based recruitments and ensure that all candidates are duly notified.
history.administration_response: The conditions/criteria in the application of roster-based recruitments and the requirement to ensure that all candidates are duly notified are specified in chapters 5 and 10 of the Staff Selection System Manual. Furthermore, under section 5.15 of the newly issued administrative instruction on downsizing or restructuring resulting in termination of appointments (ST/AI/2023/1), hiring managers are no longer permitted to make selections from the roster prior to the closing date of the job opening. Accordingly, the Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and is requesting its closure by the Board.
history.board_assessment: Given that hiring managers are no longer permitted to make selections from the roster prior to the closing date of the job opening, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
